inv.desc_en:
Local for rent with a net profitability of 4.00%, with an established client. It has 82.80 m2 of space in a prime location on Calle Fuencarral.

The premises have a built area of 82.80 m2, divided into 66.47 m2 on the ground floor, 16.33 m2 in the basement, and a 3-meter facade.

Solid contract with guarantees, duration, mandatory compliance, and appropriate price updates to ensure the investment.

If you wish to know more details about the property or would like to arrange a visit, contact us so that a specialized consultant can assist you.
